```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr

# Create the Chrono system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
system.SetGravity(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -9.81, 0))

# Initialize Irrlicht visualization
vis = irr.ChIrrApp(system, "ANCF Cable Beam Simulation", irr.dimension2du(800, 600))
vis.AddTypicalLights()
vis.AddTypicalCamera(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 3, 5))  # Position camera for viewing

# Create the ANCF cable beam
beam = chrono.ChBodyBeamANCF()
beam.SetGeometryType(chrono.ChBeamANCF.GEOM_CABLE)  # Use cable geometry
beam.SetAxisSize(chrono.ChVectorD(0.01, 0.01))  # Cross-sectional dimensions (radius for cable)
beam.SetTotalLength(10.0)  # Length of the beam
beam.SetNumElements(20)    # Number of elements along the beam
beam.SetYoungModulus(210e9)  # Young's modulus (steel)
beam.SetDensity(7800)      # Density (steel)
beam.SetTotalMass(beam.GetTotalMass())  # Ensure mass is computed correctly

# Position the beam along the X-axis starting at (0,0,0)
beam.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))

# Fix the first node to the ground using a constraint
link = chrono.ChLinkLockPointFrameN()
link.Initialize(beam, chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0)), chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0)))
system.AddLink(link)

# Add the beam to the system and visualization
system.Add(beam)
vis.Add(beam)  # Add the beam to the Irrlicht scene

# Simulation loop parameters
vis.SetTimestep(0.005)
vis.SetTryRealtime(True)

# Run the simulation
while vis.Run():
    system.DoStepDynamics()
    
    # Visualize nodal positions with small spheres
    mesh = beam.GetMesh()
    nodes = mesh.GetNodes()
    for node in nodes:
        pos = node.GetPos()
        vis.GetSceneManager().drawAll().drawSphere(pos, 0.05, chrono.ChColor(1, 0, 0))
```

```python
import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.fea as fea
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model1: A beam composed of 10 ANCF cable elements, with one end hinged to
# ground, moving under gravity alone.
# This model demonstrates the use of the utility class ChBuilderCableANCF.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Model1:
    def __init__(self, system, mesh):
        # Create a section, i.e., define thickness and material properties for the cable beam
        msection_cable2 = fea.ChBeamSectionCable()
        msection_cable2.SetDiameter(0.015)  # Set the diameter of the cable section to 15 mm
        msection_cable2.SetYoungModulus(0.01e9)  # Set the Young's modulus (0.01 GPa)
        msection_cable2.SetRayleighDamping(0.0001)  # Changed damping to 0.0001

        # Create a ChBuilderCableANCF helper object
        builder = fea.ChBuilderCableANCF()

        # Build the beam
        builder.BuildBeam(
            mesh,
            msection_cable2,
            10,
            chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, -0.1),
            chrono.ChVectorD(0.5, 0, -0.1)
        )

        # Apply boundary conditions and loads
        nodes = builder.GetLastBeamNodes()
        nodes[0].SetForce(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -0.7, 0))  # Changed force to -0.7

        # Create and add the fixed truss body to the system
        mtruss = chrono.ChBody()
        mtruss.SetFixed(True)
        system.Add(mtruss)  # Added to the system

        # Create hinge constraint and add to the system
        constraint_hinge = fea.ChLinkNodeFrame()
        constraint_hinge.Initialize(nodes[-1], mtruss)
        system.Add(constraint_hinge)

# Initialize the system and mesh
```
